errors.text: The proposed V/Nb substitution and oxygen-assisted precipitation route does not reconstruct the Cr-addition intervention or the reticulated Laves-phase mediator.

No supporting evidence is cited for oxygen producing coherent nanoscale oxide precipitates in this alloy; oxygen commonly causes interstitial strengthening with reduced ductility or forms brittle Hf/Zr-rich oxides.
Carbide precipitation is proposed despite no carbon addition or carbon source being specified.
Nb is not lighter than Zr on an atomic-mass basis, so substituting Nb for Zr would not support the stated density-reduction mechanism.
The baseline is mischaracterized as having limited ductility due to brittle-phase formation even though the target baseline is a single-phase BCC alloy.
